author: MarioNawfal
text:
🇾🇪🇸🇦 The Houthis have named their price for stopping, and it's cheaper than anything Saudi Arabia is about to try instead

Ansar Allah's spokesman said it in an interview today. 

No more territory, no more offensives, if Riyadh lifts the ten-year blockade, stops arming the mercenaries and stops bombing.

Dimitri Lascaris calls that a set of obligations Saudi Arabia already has under international law, offered as a truce.

What they hold now matters more than land.

Mocha, the island of Perim in the middle of the passage, and reportedly the Hanish Islands:

"they control the Bab al-Mandib Strait six ways from Sunday"

The smart move is consolidating that rather than bleeding for Aden.

Saudi Arabia, with the world's seventh-largest defense budget, just watched its proxies collapse on camera, and MBS is in Cairo asking for troops.

Lascaris goes further: Somaliland's leader begged for Israeli forces the day after Mocha fell, and the Houthis would welcome the chance to hit Israelis somewhere they can reach.

@dimitrilascaris @WeTheBrandon
